vibe: modern bank, earthy, organic, premium botanical

design_philosophy.description: Evolving the green and coral identity into a richer, tactile, and organic financial experience. We are using deep forest greens and earthy terracotta to ground the user, complemented by warm sand/cream backgrounds for a premium, editorial magazine feel. Tension is created through organic shapes contrasted with strict, reliable banking grids.

headings.usage: Used for balances, hero titles, and large numbers. Provides a premium, editorial, 'new money' feel.

body.usage: Highly legible, geometric yet friendly body text for tables, descriptions, and UI elements.

numbers.usage: For tabular data, transaction IDs, and exact metrics to ensure alignment and tech-forward reliability.

css_recipes.card-soft: bg-surface border border-border-light shadow-sm rounded-[var(--radius)] overflow-hidden
css_recipes.glass-pill: backdrop-blur-md bg-surface/80 border border-border-light shadow-sm rounded-full
css_recipes.btn-primary: bg-brand text-white dark:text-app-bg hover:bg-brand-hover rounded-full px-6 py-3 font-medium transition-all
css_recipes.btn-accent: bg-accent-main text-white hover:bg-accent-hover rounded-full px-6 py-3 font-medium transition-all

auth_pages.concept: Single centered glass card floating over a full-bleed botanical background.
auth_pages.card_style: max-w-md w-full bg-surface/90 backdrop-blur-2xl border border-border-light shadow-2xl rounded-3xl p-8 sm:p-10
auth_pages.typography: Logo wordmark 'Naturalis' centered at text-3xl font-heading font-bold text-brand tracking-tight. Subtitles in text-text-secondary text-sm.
auth_pages.inputs: Shadcn inputs with bg-transparent border-b-2 border-border-default rounded-none px-0 py-2 focus-visible:ring-0 focus-visible:border-brand transition-colors.

home_dashboard.concept: Premium editorial magazine layout with an app-feed feel. Cards feel tactile and grounded.
home_dashboard.spacing_rhythm: Generous spacing. gap-6 on mobile, gap-8 on desktop. Padding p-6 or p-8 inside cards.

hero_balance_section.layout: High-contrast massive typography. Left-aligned on desktop, centered on mobile.
hero_balance_section.typography: text-5xl lg:text-7xl font-heading font-black tracking-tighter text-text-primary
hero_balance_section.actions: Deposit & Withdraw as large side-by-side .glass-pill buttons underneath the balance.
hero_balance_section.background: Uses .hero-gradient with subtle .grain overlay to break up digital flatness.

daily_claim_widget.layout: A narrow, full-width 'ribbon' card (.card-soft) with a subtle brand-soft background.
daily_claim_widget.design: Flex layout. Left side: 'Daily Reward' + Countdown clock. Right side: Glowing accent claim button.

featured_investment_plan.design: Col-span-8: Image of lush nature/architecture with an inner shadow overlay. Col-span-4: Typographic stats block (Daily %, Days, ROI) with a large 'Invest from ₦X' call to action.
featured_investment_plan.style: Strict .card-soft, zero padding on the image side, p-8 on the text side.

quick_actions_feed.layout: Horizontal scroll on mobile (snap-x), 3-column grid on desktop.
quick_actions_feed.design: Square cards for 'Invite & earn', 'Redeem coupon', 'Your packages'. Each features a large lucide-react icon with a subtle background circle in brand-soft.

welcome_modal.design: Elegant dialog card. No harsh borders. Features a top image (botanical theme), bold welcome text, and a primary CTA alongside a muted Telegram button.

testing.attributes: All interactive elements, forms, and key informational elements (balances, rewards) MUST have a `data-testid` attribute (e.g., `data-testid='deposit-button'`, `data-testid='wallet-balance'`).
